findings.detail: X02 is firing on unfunded/undrawn private-credit commitments whose source rows intentionally have no Reference, Spread, or Interest Rate.

rationale: The flagged sample rows with blank extracted interest_rate are undrawn debt commitments. Raw SOI rows for AAH Topco and ACI Group Holdings show Type of Investment as First Lien - Undrawn and the filing itself prints no Reference, Spread, or Interest Rate for those rows. The extracted blank rate therefore matches source; the X02 check is over-scoped for unfunded/undrawn commitments rather than identifying a missing coupon extraction.
